teaser: Three times tonight you started to say what you actually feel, and three times you folded it back into something gentler. That is what it looks like when life path 33 — the compound number a birth date adds up to before it gets reduced to one digit — meets INFP, a type built on feeling as its first language. The two do not compete for attention so much as agree too quickly, both leaning toward the same open hand. What is particular here is the quiet math of how much of you is left over once everyone else has been tended to, and whether it still adds up by the end of an ordinary day.
